assessment: The income case received support from EPD distribution growth and a strong two-year return, while its Treasury comparison remains dependent on the chosen instrument and horizon. The article is useful on wrapper fees and tax frictions. Its spot-ETF launch count and debt-duration terminology are incorrect. The conditional April RRP depletion scenario did not trigger, and the predicted QT taper occurred with balances still positive. January 20 is the text publication date despite the January 21 URL.
verification_limitations: Retrieved November 7, 2026; the current webpage is not authenticated as the original publication-date wording.
Chart labels were read but pixels and proprietary indicator vintages were not inspected.

Adjusted-close evidence is a vendor proxy for reinvested distributions and splits, in USD without fees or taxes. It does not reconstruct actual portfolio trades. Chosen sensitivity windows are not author deadlines. Macro series use latest vintages.
